entry.title: Doppelgänger Core RFID Dev Board
entry.summary:
Vendor: Mayweather
Type: RFID
Price: 60.00

INTRODUCTION

The Doppelgänger Core, is an advanced hardware module for RFID pentesting functionality. While specifically designed to be embedded in Long-Range RFID readers, it can also be used as a Wiegand/Data implant for wireless exfiltration of RFID and PIN credentials.

The module supports both Wiegand and Data formats, enabling capture of credentials from HID Global, Paxton, and Indala systems. Designed for reduced wiring and simplified installation, making it an ideal choice for custom long-range data interpreter builds.

This product is the module only. It can be implanted into on-site readers, or integrated into a custom reader.

The included cross-platform UI tool, Doppelgänger Assistant provides all the functionality you need in one place, optimised for in-the-field use, and a full pentest life-cycle:

  1. Capture: Capture RFID and PIN credentials
  2. Control: Manage multiple devices, analyse, save, tag and exfiltrate captured credentials via the cross-platform WebUI.
  3. Clone: Emulate, clone and write captured credentials directly from the UI via Proxmark 3. One click & wireless: No command lines, no code.
  4. Access: Gain and escalate access via cloned RFID Credentials.

COMPATABILITY AND TECHNICAL DETAILS

The PPE iCLASS Longrange RFID Capture System is optimised for iCLASS systems. Depending on your target, there are Long-Range solutions for Low-Frequency HID and Indala systems and Paxton systems.

Long-Range RFID capture is the holy-grail for security auditors and penetration testers. To date, the only solutions have been either complicated and unpractical in the field, or out-of-production and abandoned.

The Long-Range RFID Capture by PPE changes everything. It is a modern, complete solution that covers all elements of the RFID Audit life-cycle.   2. Control: Manage multiple devices, analyse, save, tag and exfiltrate captured credentials via the cross-platform WebUI.
  3. Clone: Emulate, clone and write captured credentials directly from the UI via Proxmark 3. One click & wireless: No command lines, no code.
  4. Access: Gain and escalate access via cloned RFID Credentials.

Built for professional red teamers and physical penetration testers in commercial or industrial environments with Paxton Net2 badge systems, with real-world performance that allows for advanced audit possibilities: vehicles, closets, or target perimeters.

The Paxton P200 Long-Range Reader can also function as a Stealth Decoy Reader. Stealth Decoy Reader products from PPE provide a new vector for credential capture and exfiltration. By deploying decoy readers in and around a target's premises, credentials can be quickly harvested without requiring risky and invasive techniques: wire splicing, reader damage, decoration damage, etc.

The Paxton P200 Dual Mode reader includes the Doppelgänger Core module for Long Range work; customers can also add the Doppelgänger Stealth module according to operational requirements.

The Long Range Reader + Doppelgänger Core are delivered ready-to-use. Turn on the reader, start collecting credentials. Select a badge to clone, and write or emulate it with one click.

entry.title: Long Range RFID Reader / Writer DL533N XL
entry.summary:
Vendor: D-Logic
Type: Reader / Writer
Price: 129.00

The world's only LibNFC Compatible Long Range Reader / Writer

The DL533N XL is the first publicly available Long Range, LibNFC Compatible Reading / Writing Device, providing read, write and sniff distances of up to 180mm.

Based on the rock-solid DL533N hardware, the XL is 178x178mm, with a built in active RF range-booster providing unmatched reading distances without any dead spots.

Compatible out of the box with LibNFC on Windows, MacOS, Linux and Android, this is a stable RFID reader / writer perfectly suited and tested with our badges.

Finally, long-distance high-frequency RFID sniffing is practical.

Specifications

  • Dimensions: 178 x 178 x 6mm
  • Max Read / Write Distance: 180mm

Operates in the following modes:

  • ISO/IEC 14443A/MIFARE® Reader/Writer
  • FeliCa Reader/Writer
  • ISO/IEC 14443B Reader/Writer
  • ISO/IEC 14443A/MIFARE Classic® 1K or MIFARE Classic® 4K emulation
  • FeliCa Card emulation
  • ISO/IEC 18092, ECMA 340 Peer-to-Peer

Compatible Systems

Device is compatible with the following operating systems

  • Windows: XP, 7, 8, 10 (All Versions)
  • MacOS (All Versions)
  • Linux: Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS, etc (All Versions)
  • Android: Specific Builds

Compatible Tools

Device is compatible with LibNFC, including the following tools:

  • nfc-mfclassic (Read/Write MIFARE Classic® 1K or MIFARE Classic® 4K, and MIFARE Classic® "Magic" UID cards)
  • nfc-mfsetuid (Set the UID on MIFARE Classic® "Magic" UID cards)
  • nfc-mfultralight (Read/Write MIFARE Ultralight / MIFARE Ultralight EV1, NTAG etc cards)
  • mfoc (MIFARE Classic® 1K / 4K cracking with known key)
  • mfcuk (MIFARE Classic® 1K / 4K cracking without known key)

Covert

Slim form-factor allows for covert concealment (briefcase, backpack, books, under desks, etc)

Works on everything - with everything. Windows, Linux, MacOS, Android; Based on the NXP PN533 Chipset - Supports a huge range of cards.

Huge Operational Distance

Read, Write, Sniff and Crack at distances up to 18cm. For red-teams and pentesters, open a new world of practical attacks
